```{r setup}
params <- list(
  seed = 12435,
  workers = 4,
  interactive = TRUE,
  prior_count = 2,
  low_q_threshold = 0.25,
  high_q_threshold = 0.74,
  gene_fdr_threshold = 0.05,
  pathway_fdr_threshold = 0.05,
  rds_dir = "../results/rds_slc6a8_continuous/",
  table_dir = "../results/tables_slc6a8_continuous/",
  data_dir = "../data/",
  fig_dir = "../results/figures_slc6a8_continuous/",
  msigdb_dir = "../../references/MSigDb_2025.1/"
)

# Load packages ----------------------------------------------------------------
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(BiocParallel)
  library(yaml)
  library(DT)
  library(writexl)
  library(yulab.utils)
  library(edgeR)
  library(limma)
  library(unikn)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(patchwork)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(RColorBrewer)
  library(tibble)
  library(tidyr)
  library(knitr)
  library(stringr)
  library(purrr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(data.table)
  library(forcats)
  library(scales)
  library(factoextra)
  library(ggridges)
  library(car)
  library(reshape2)
  library(matrixStats)
  library(kableExtra)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(readxl)
  library(GSVA)
})

# Load functions ---------------------------------------------------------------
source("../../scripts/functions.R", local = TRUE)
source("../../scripts/GSEA_camera.R")
source("../../scripts/makeFitObject.R")

# Load globals -----------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(params$seed)

if(!dir.exists(params$rds_dir)) dir.create(params$rds_dir, recursive = TRUE)
if(!dir.exists(params$fig_dir)) dir.create(params$fig_dir, recursive = TRUE)
if(!dir.exists(params$table_dir)) dir.create(params$table_dir, recursive = TRUE)

de_table_cols <- c(
  "GENEID", "Symbol", "logFC", "logCPM", "F", "PValue", "FDR"
)

round_de_table_cols <- c(
  "logFC", "logCPM", "F", "PValue", "FDR"
)

shiny_path <- file.path(
  params$rds_dir, "shiny", "rds"
)

msigdb_dir <- "../../references/MSigDb_2025.1/"
gene_sets <- readRDS(file.path(params$msigdb_dir, "msigdb_v2025.1.Hs_gene_sets.rds"))
```

# Heme biosynthesis

```{r}
theme_pub <- function() {
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
      strip.background  = element_rect(fill = "#f0f0f0", color = "grey60"),
      strip.text        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
      plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      plot.subtitle     = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey40"),
      legend.position   = "right"
    )
}
```

# Erythroid signature differentiation score

```{r results='asis'}
eryth_pattern <- paste(
  "ERYTHRO", "ERYTHROID", "ERYTHROBLAST", "HEMOGLOBIN", "GLOBIN",
  "HEME_BIOSYNTH", "HEME_METABOL", "PORPHYRIN",
  "GATA1", "KLF1", "TAL1",
  "MEGAKARYOCYTE_ERYTHROID", "MEP",
  "BFU", "CFU_E", "PROERYTHROBLAST", "RETICULOCYTE",
  sep = "|"
)

eryth_sets <- gene_sets %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  filter(
    grepl(eryth_pattern, geneset_name, ignore.case = TRUE) |
    grepl("erythroid|erythroblast|heme biosynth|hemoglobin",
          description_brief, ignore.case = TRUE)
  )

cat("Erythroid/differentiation gene sets found:", nrow(eryth_sets), "\n")

print(htmltools::tagList(datatable(eryth_sets[,c("collection_name", "geneset_name", "n_ensembl")],
                                   extensions = "Buttons", options = list(
                                     dom = "Bfrtip",
                                     buttons = c("copy", "csv", "excel")
                                   )) ))
```

```{r }
eryth_gs_list <- setNames(
  lapply(eryth_sets$ensembl, function(x) as.character(x)),
  eryth_sets$geneset_name
)

gene = c( "ENSG00000130821")
ridx <- which(dge_red_norm$genes[, "GENEID"] %in% gene)
expr_logcpm <- dge_red_norm$counts

expr_logcpm_dedup <- expr_logcpm

overlap_n     <- sapply(eryth_gs_list, function(g) sum(g %in% rownames(expr_logcpm_dedup)))
eryth_gs_list <- eryth_gs_list[overlap_n >= 5]
cat("\nGene sets retained (≥5 genes in matrix):", length(eryth_gs_list), "\n")
print(head(sort(overlap_n[names(eryth_gs_list)], decreasing = TRUE)))
cat("...\n")
```

```{r results='asis'}
gsva_par <- gsvaParam(
  exprData = expr_logcpm_dedup,
  geneSets = eryth_gs_list,
  kcdf     = "Gaussian",
  minSize  = 5,
  maxSize  = 500
)
gsva_scores <- gsva(gsva_par, verbose = TRUE)

cat("\nGSVA score matrix:", nrow(gsva_scores), "pathways ×",
    ncol(gsva_scores), "samples\n")
```

```{r}
eryth_consensus <- colMeans(gsva_scores)

score_df <- data.frame(
  sample          = colnames(gsva_scores),
  eryth_score     = eryth_consensus,
  t(gsva_scores),
  check.names     = FALSE
) %>%
  left_join(
    dge_red$samples %>%
      select(OriginalSampleName, slc6a8_norm_logcpm, slc6a8_raw,
             FLT3_ITD, NPM1, RUNX1, ASXL1, TP53, cohort,
             perc_blasts, specimenType) %>%
      rename(sample = OriginalSampleName),
    by = "sample"
  )
score_df$slc6a8_norm_cqn <- dge_red_norm$counts[gene, ]
```

### Erythroid score vs SLC6A8 - adjusted {.tabset}

#### Global

```{r}
design <- model.matrix(
  ~ slc6a8_norm_logcpm + FLT3_ITD + NPM1 + RUNX1 + ASXL1 + TP53 +
    cohort + specimenType + perc_blasts,
  data = score_df
)

X_cov <- design[, colnames(design) != "slc6a8_norm_logcpm", drop = FALSE]

score_df$slc6a8_logcpm_resid <- lm.fit(X_cov, score_df$slc6a8_norm_logcpm)$residuals

design <- model.matrix(
  ~ eryth_score + FLT3_ITD + NPM1 + RUNX1 + ASXL1 + TP53 +
    cohort + specimenType + perc_blasts,
  data = score_df
)

X_cov <- design[, colnames(design) != "eryth_score", drop = FALSE]

score_df$eryth_resid <- lm.fit(X_cov, score_df$eryth_score)$residuals

ct <- cor.test(score_df$eryth_resid, score_df$slc6a8_logcpm_resid, method = "pearson")
if (ct$p.value == 0) ct$p.value <- 2.2e-16
lab_cor <- sprintf("pearson ρ = %.2f\n pvalue = %.2g", ct$estimate, ct$p.value)
p_adj <- ggplot(score_df, aes(x = slc6a8_logcpm_resid, y = eryth_resid)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.4, color = "#555555") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "#E05C5C", se = TRUE, linewidth = 0.9) +
  annotate("label", x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = lab_cor,
           hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.2, size = 3.2, fill = "white",
           label.size = 0.3) +
  labs(
    x = "SLC6A8 (CQN-normalized)",
    y = "Erythroid score",
    title    = "Consensus erythroid score vs. SLC6A8 - covariate-adjusted",
    subtitle = "Adjusted for clinical/ technical covariates; Red line= linear fit"
  ) +
  theme_pub()
p_adj
```

## Regress out erythroid composition

```{r}
bm_prop <- fread("../results/tables_slc6a8_continuous/CIBERSORTx_BM.csv") %>% as.data.frame()
pb_prop <- fread("../results/tables_slc6a8_continuous/CIBERSORTx_PB.csv") %>% as.data.frame()

bm_eryth_cols <- grep("eryth", colnames(bm_prop), value = TRUE)
pb_eryth_cols <- grep("eryth", colnames(pb_prop), value = TRUE)

bm_prop$eryth_sum <- rowSums(bm_prop[, bm_eryth_cols, drop = FALSE])
pb_prop$eryth_sum <- rowSums(pb_prop[, pb_eryth_cols, drop = FALSE])

score_df<- score_df |>
  dplyr::left_join(bm_prop[, c("Mixture", "eryth_sum")],
                   by = c("sample" = "Mixture")) |>
  dplyr::rename(bm_eryth = eryth_sum) |>
  dplyr::left_join(pb_prop[, c("Mixture", "eryth_sum")],
                   by = c("sample" = "Mixture")) |>
  dplyr::rename(pb_eryth = eryth_sum)

score_df$eryth_prop <- ifelse(
  score_df$specimenType == "Bone Marrow Aspirate",
  score_df$bm_eryth,
  score_df$pb_eryth
)
```

```{r}
design <- model.matrix(
  ~ slc6a8_norm_logcpm + FLT3_ITD + NPM1 + RUNX1 + ASXL1 + TP53 +
    cohort + specimenType + perc_blasts + eryth_prop,
  data = score_df
)

X_cov <- design[, colnames(design) != "slc6a8_norm_logcpm", drop = FALSE]

score_df$slc6a8_logcpm_resid_eryth_corrected <- lm.fit(X_cov, score_df$slc6a8_norm_logcpm)$residuals

design <- model.matrix(
  ~ eryth_score + FLT3_ITD + NPM1 + RUNX1 + ASXL1 + TP53 +
    cohort + specimenType + perc_blasts + eryth_prop,
  data = score_df
)

X_cov <- design[, colnames(design) != "eryth_score", drop = FALSE]

score_df$eryth_resid_eryth_corrected <- lm.fit(X_cov, score_df$eryth_score)$residuals

ct <- cor.test(score_df$eryth_resid_eryth_corrected, score_df$slc6a8_logcpm_resid_eryth_corrected, method = "pearson")
if (ct$p.value == 0) ct$p.value <- 2.2e-16
lab_cor <- sprintf("pearson ρ = %.2f\n pvalue = %.2g", ct$estimate, ct$p.value)
p_adj <- ggplot(score_df, aes(x = slc6a8_logcpm_resid_eryth_corrected, y = eryth_resid_eryth_corrected)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.4, color = "#555555") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "#E05C5C", se = TRUE, linewidth = 0.9) +
  annotate("label", x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = lab_cor,
           hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.2, size = 3.2, fill = "white",
           label.size = 0.3) +
  labs(
    x = "SLC6A8 (CQN-normalized)",
    y = "Erythroid score",
    title    = "Consensus erythroid score vs. SLC6A8 - covariate-adjusted",
    subtitle = "Adjusted for clinical/ technical covariates; Red line= linear fit"
  ) +
  theme_pub()
p_adj
```
